client_review: Rabbit colourway was decided as the vest colour because every rabbit has the same brown body. Confirm this and approve the six vest names.
Rabbit vests seen only in piles and too small to use: rainbow, orange and yellow, lilac with rainbow trim, green, purple, red and pink. Please send single photos if these are sold.

Cat: pink, orange, mint green, blue and yellow cats appear only in market piles. They are listed as colourways without images. Please send single photos. Cream cats with blue or red bags may be one colourway with two trims.
Soft yellow floppy-eared figures in dresses (in img-024 and img-087) look like a separate rabbit or doll style. They were not used. Confirm what they are.
Monkey: five colourways seen. Tan with pale yellow face (img-073) may be the same design as brown with yellow face (img-078). Confirm.
Monkey photos show two or four monkeys together, so listings share photos. Single-monkey photos are needed for a clean product page.

Bear goes to More animals. Turquoise and tan bears have lifestyle photos only. Votes: bears were decided with koala as the main alternative (img-030 had 5 koala alternative votes). Confirm bear versus koala.
Dog has one photo with flowers in frame. Confirm whether other dog colours exist.
All shownSize values are null. Sizes S, M, L, XL need client input.
